en.html:
獅子吼"...You allowed them inside the residence?"
獅子吼"His Highness Kuniuji is here!!"
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"N-no excuse to offer, sir!"
獅子吼"The attackers' strength."
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"The report says they came in with one car... At most a few people, I would think."
獅子吼"A few people only, and you could not stop them. A car drives straight at this residence, and you watch it pass as if you are waiting at a red light to cross the road—is this your report?"
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"Y-yes... B-but... as Your Excellency is aware, the defenses of this main residence at present can hardly be called complete..."
獅子吼"...Tch."
花枝"............"
獅子吼(Who? An occupation-force sabotage unit that broke through the border?)
獅子吼(No... What is a GHQ agent gaining by this sort of foolish assault? Even those swine would conduct themselves with a little more sense.)
獅子吼(This... does not agree with reason. Which means the work of people who disposed of reason long ago.)
獅子吼(Simple, witless violence. No thought, no judgment... Only: I wish to do it, therefore I do it. Such a manner.)
獅子吼(Who... is this?)

獅子吼"..."

獅子吼"............"
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"Y-Your Excellency!?"
獅子吼"Do not make a commotion. You are before Lady Hanae."
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"B-b-but... Lady Kanae has returned, he said—"
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"That... that Lady Kanae... Is that not, well, an utterly enormous danger!?"
獅子吼"...How often do you intend to make me say it?"
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"————"
獅子吼"There is nothing so remarkable about it. We have learned who the attackers are. That is all."
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"Y-yes... sir."
獅子吼"I shall go to intercept them."
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"...Your Excellency, personally!?"
獅子吼"With even Toba in that condition, what is to be done unless I take command? Move Lady Hanae farther inside."
獅子吼"And recall the warriors outside into the residence."
ｅｔｃ／大鳥兵士Ｃ"U-understood, sir!"
花枝"............"
